description: Asks the published result type of mixed-type addition and multiplication in both operand orders (Currency/Double, Single/Long, Single/Double, Currency/Long, Decimal with Double/Currency/Long, Boolean and Date operands) over the stored Vals row, as Field.Type and returned VARIANT tag in one projection. A second projection asks the inner VarType of the same expressions where VarType is admitted. Fixture r-expr-1-main2 is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and loaded modules are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
retentionNote: Designed r-expr-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
